What to verify: Confirm the current RFP, amendments, appendices and required forms; record their versions.
Compare project IDs and the legal bidder name across all parts of the final package.
Reconcile totals, subtotals, tax, currency and arithmetic with the approved price schedule.
Confirm milestones, calendar or working days, and each deadline’s triggering event.
Check the validity period and its starting event against the current RFP.
Compare warranty, response and resolution commitments across sections and with the RFP.
For every mandatory requirement, locate the actual response and evidence; review conditions and exceptions.
Verify the required qualifications, certificates, authorization and attachment references.
Have the responsible person verify required signatures, seals and internal approvals.
Open the final exported files; check completeness, formatting, names, size limits and required file types.
Verify the correct channel, deadline, timezone and responsible submitter against the current instructions.
Close unresolved items; recheck final changes and archive the submitted package and any acknowledgement.
